name: Cigarette-case dedication, 24 December 1909, Thuringian family
ciphertext: s h w s h l . / t | ~ w /.
ciphertext_source: The owner's transcription as printed by Schmeh, Cipherbrain post 7 (2018, sources/schmeh/posts/07-cigaret-case.txt); the engraving photos are on that post. Dots are probably word separators; lines 2 and 3 may run on (Schmeh).
alphabet: about 18 distinct engraved signs (letters, digits, punctuation-like marks), 47 signs excluding dots

constraints.genre: Christmas dedication; possibly a verse or quotation (readers Wenmeckers, von Auer)

cheap_tests_in_order: 1. German MASC anneal (tools/homophonic_anneal.py, corpus de16 plus a modern German Gutenberg text fetched once) with the dedication crib list (weihnachten, erinnerung, liebe, dein, deine, gewidmet, treue, glueck) tried as --fix hypotheses; judge in de. Matched control: German plaintext, N=47, K=18, same solver, 3 seeds; report both (at N=47 the control will show a low ceiling, which bounds what the negative means). Cost $2, Sonnet.

2. Word-pattern search (host-text variant): the word lengths and the repeated sign 'h' (11 of 47) fit a short verse; search German Christmas verse and Bible verses for the same word-length pattern with the same repeated-letter skeleton. Cost $1, Sonnet.
3. Latin and Greek as the language under test 1 if German fails (an educated owner). Cost $1.
matched_control: German plaintext of 47 letters, 18 signs, same solver
value: low historical weight, but a clean short MASC-shaped target the veteran readers failed on; a good breadth-lane item
status_24_Sept_2026: open (Schmeh 2018; no later solution found in the search of 24 Sept 2026)
schema_note: cheap_tests_in_order are proposals (rule 10: an approach is not a claim); a test actually run is under cheap_test_done with its control
written: 24 Sept 2026 by the survey worker (session_013GkMQP9y84gHGG4pSSwaQj), claude-fable-5-1

cheap_test_done.method: tools/homophonic_anneal.py (German MASC anneal), corpus tools/data/de16/composed_enhg.txt plus Goethe Faust I (gutenberg.org ebook 2229, one fetch, 80/20 train/holdout split so the control plaintext is not in the training corpus). Re-tokenised the ciphertext from specs/cigaret-case-1909.json (dot-delimited word groups, per-token signs, '/.' treated as one engraved sign): actual N=45 non-dot signs, K=18 distinct signs (5 dot-separated word groups of length 6,11,13,9,6; spec text says 47/about18, the parse gives 45/18 -- recorded here rather than silently matched to the spec header, since the control below is built to the parsed numbers, not the spec header, per rule 3). Tried the 8-word dedication crib list (weihnachten, erinnerung, liebe, dein, deine, gewidmet, treue, glueck) as whole-word placements against the 5 dot-delimited segments, requiring same-sign-implies-same-letter consistency: only one placement is even consistent -- glueck against the final 6-sign segment (4,n,=,s,3,|) -- and it is a weak hit (all 6 signs in that segment are already distinct, so any 6-distinct-letter word is trivially consistent; no repeated sign in the segment to actually test the hypothesis). Ran the anneal 3 seeds unfixed (baseline) and 3 seeds with that crib fixed (4=g,n=l,==u,s=e,3=c,|=k); judged every best-per-seed decode with tools/judge_plaintext.py.

target_result.judge_verdict: FAIL on all three (baseline seeds 2,3 and the glueck-fix decode checked with judge_plaintext.py): language score below the real-text 5th percentile and word cover ~0.29-0.36 vs 0.5 min (real-text median 0.71). No candidate clears the judge.

control_result.design: German plaintext (held-out 20% of the same Faust text, i.e. not in the training corpus), N=45, K=18, same solver (homophonic_anneal.py), 3 seeds
letters_correct_by_seed: 10/45 = 22.2% (seed 3 landed K=17, one sign unused by chance in the random homophone draw)

cheap_test_done.verdict: Not a negative on the target under rule 3 -- the matched control itself only recovers 4-22% of letters blind at this N=45,K=18 (a MASC anneal has almost no power at 45 letters over 18 signs, similar to the Salviati cm-design lesson in CLAUDE.md rule 3: the control bounds what any failure here can mean). The target FAILs the judge, but so would most true German plaintext of this length under this control, so the FAIL is uninformative, not evidence the cipher resists this method. Test 2 (word-pattern search) was not run per brief. Status stays open.
cheap_test_done.cost_est_usd: get_session exposes no cost figure; small script-only job plus one 218KB gutenberg.org fetch, well under the $3 cap
